      MC_AGENT_IMAGE_PREFIX: ${MC_AGENT_IMAGE_PREFIX-ghcr.io/argyelan-ai/}
      MC_AGENT_IMAGE_TAG: ${MC_AGENT_IMAGE_TAG:-latest}
      HOST_UID: ${HOST_UID:-502}
      # Same uid alignment as the backend service (see there).
      PUID: ${PUID:-}
      PGID: ${PGID:-}
      CLI_BRIDGE_TOKEN: ${CLI_BRIDGE_TOKEN:-}
      CLI_BRIDGE_TOKEN_FILE: ${CLI_BRIDGE_TOKEN_FILE:-}
      MC_MCP_REGISTRY_DIR: ${HOME}/.mc/mcp-servers
      MC_AGENTS_ROOT: ${HOME}/.mc/agents
    volumes:
      - ${HOME}/.mc:${HOME}/.mc
      - ${HOME}/.mc/deliverables:/deliverables:ro
      - mc_shared_deliverables:/shared-deliverables
      - ${HOME}/.mc/mcp-screenshots:/shared-mcp
      - ./backend/templates:/app/templates:ro
      - ./docker:${MC_REPO_PATH:-${HOME}/Workspace/Projects/mission-control}/docker:rw
      - ./docker-compose.yml:${MC_REPO_PATH:-${HOME}/Workspace/Projects/mission-control}/docker-compose.yml:ro
      - ./.env:${MC_REPO_PATH:-${HOME}/Workspace/Projects/mission-control}/.env:ro
      - ./jarvis_core:/app/jarvis_core:ro
      - ./scripts/node-agent:/app/scripts/node-agent:ro
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    # Kein HTTP-Port: Lifeness via Herzschlag-Datei (siehe mc-deploy SKILL.md
    # + app/worker.py _heartbeat_loop). Der alte os.kill(1, 0)-Check war eine
    # Tautologie (PID 1 = der Worker selbst, konnte nie fehlschlagen) — der
    # Check meldet jetzt unhealthy, wenn der Ereignis-Loop haengt/stirbt und
    # /tmp/mc-worker.alive aelter als 90 s wird.
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python -c \"import os, time; os.path.exists('/tmp/mc-worker.alive') and time.time() - os.path.getmtime('/tmp/mc-worker.alive') < 90 or exit(1)\""]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  frontend:
    # Prebuilt-Image nutzt die Default-Brand ("Mission.Control"); eigene
    # NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND braucht einen lokalen Build (Build-Arg wird gebacken).
    image: ghcr.io/argyelan-ai/mc-frontend:${MC_IMAGE_TAG:-latest}
    build:
      context: ./frontend-v2
      args:
        # Baked into the Next.js build (server-actions origin allowlist).
        PUBLIC_HOST: ${PUBLIC_HOST:-}
        # Wordmark/brand, e.g. "my-lab.io" ("main.accent" split at last dot).
        NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND:-}
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *default-logging
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ""
      PUBLIC_HOST: ${PUBLIC_HOST:-}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3000:3000"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "node -e \"require('http').get('http://localhost:3000', r => process.exit(r.statusCode < 400 ? 0 : 1)).on('error', () => process.exit(1))\""]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  qdrant:
    # Pinned (not :latest) so a `docker compose pull`/recreate can't silently
    # swap the vector-store binary under existing mc_qdrant_data. Bump this
    # tag deliberately when upgrading; check release notes for storage-format
    # changes first. Verified current as of 2026-10-17 (matched :latest's
    # digest via `docker buildx imagetools inspect`).
    image: qdrant/qdrant:v1.19.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Same Docker-Desktop default gap as db (1s without this line). qdrant is
    # the vector store behind Vault and Memory (mc_qdrant_data holds the
    # storage segments). On SIGKILL it can't close those segments cleanly,
    # forcing crash-recovery on the next start. 60s, same as db: aligned by
    # role (persistent storage engine, not a cache), not by measurement —
    # nobody has isolated-tested qdrant's own shutdown path yet.
    stop_grace_period: 60s
    logging: *default-logging
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:6333:6333"
    volumes:
      - mc_qdrant_data:/qdrant/storage
    healthcheck:
      # qdrant image enthaelt kein curl — TCP check via bash /dev/tcp fallback,
      # alternativ via 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/6333' oder 'timeout 2 bash -c'.
      # Einfachste portable Loesung: node via shell file-descriptor trick.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c ': > /dev/tcp/localhost/6333' 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  caddy:
    image: caddy:2-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Same Docker-Desktop default gap as db/backend (1s without this line) —
    # 10s lets Caddy drain in-flight connections gracefully on stop/reload.
    stop_grace_period: 10s
    logging: *default-logging
    depends_on:
      - frontend
      - backend
    # Secure by default: Caddy (the front door) binds to localhost only.
    # Anyone on a shared LAN could otherwise reach the app — and before the
    # first admin registers, even claim the admin account. To reach MC from
    # other devices (phone via Tailscale, LAN), set MC_BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0
    # in .env — see README "Access from your phone".
    ports:
      - "${MC_BIND_ADDRESS:-127.0.0.1}:80:80"
      - "${MC_BIND_ADDRESS:-127.0.0.1}:443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      - ./caddy/certs:/etc/caddy/certs:ro
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config

  # Visual-Verifier Service — zentrales Playwright-Setup damit Agents keine
  # eigene Browser-Installation brauchen (Bug 3 vom 2026-04-22). Ruft Backend
  # ueber `mc verify` CLI oder direkt POST /verify hier auf, schreibt
  # Screenshots in gemeinsames Volume das Backend als Deliverables registriert.
  mc-playwright:
    build: ./docker/mc-playwright
    # Optional: nur mit COMPOSE_PROFILES=browser (Visual-Verify fuer Agents).
    profiles: ["browser"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *default-logging
    environment:
      SHARED_DELIVERABLES: /shared-deliverables
    volumes:
      - mc_shared_deliverables:/shared-deliverables
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8790/health')"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # LiveKit Voice-Server — Grundlage fuer den Voice-Agent (Voice-Worker Runtime).
  # LIVEKIT_KEYS Format: "<api_key>: <api_secret>" (YAML-Mapping mit Colon+Space).
  # Beide Werte liegen im credentials-Store (ADR-033, Settings → Credentials),
  # NICHT im secrets-Store. Format-Doku: server logged "needs to be exactly,
  # 'key: secret', including the space" wenn der Space fehlt. --dev = self-
  # signed TLS, kein Cert-Needed.
  livekit:
    # Pinned (not :latest) — avoids an unexpected server swap on recreate.
    # Verified current as of 2026-10-17 (matched :latest's digest via
    # `docker buildx imagetools inspect`).
    image: livekit/livekit-server:v1.13.10
    # Optional: nur mit COMPOSE_PROFILES=voice (oder --profile voice) aktiv.
    profiles: ["voice"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *default-logging
    # --node-ip: the RTC candidate IP LiveKit advertises to clients. Set
    # LIVEKIT_NODE_IP in .env to your host's LAN/VPN IP so other devices
    # (phone, desktop) can reach voice. Default 127.0.0.1 = local-only.
    command: ["--dev", "--bind", "0.0.0.0", "--node-ip", "${LIVEKIT_NODE_IP:-127.0.0.1}"]
    environment:
      LIVEKIT_KEYS: ${LIVEKIT_KEYS}
    ports:
      # Signaling-Port (WS): nur localhost + Caddy-Proxy braucht's. Andere
      # Verbindungen kommen ueber Caddy /livekit-signal mit TLS.
      - "127.0.0.1:7880:7880"
      # WebRTC TCP-Fallback fuer Browser ohne UDP-Erreichbarkeit (z.B. iPhone
      # ohne Tailscale-UDP). 0.0.0.0 damit Tailscale-Verkehr durchkommt.
      - "7881:7881"
      # WebRTC UDP (primary media path). 0.0.0.0 fuer Tailscale-Zugriff.
      - "7882:7882/udp"
    healthcheck:
      # livekit/livekit-server ist busybox-basiert (kein bash, kein curl) —
      # nc (BusyBox netcat) prueft TCP-Connect auf :7880 ohne externe deps.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "nc -z localhost 7880 || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # voice-worker — persoenlicher Sprachassistent des Operators.
  # Hosted-Persona: Jarvis (ADR-038). Service-Name + LiveKit-Infra bleiben
  # "voice" — der Agent dahinter heisst seit dem Rename Jarvis.
  # Joint einen LiveKit-Room als Agent und spricht mit dem Operator via xAI
  # Grok Realtime API. Tool-Calls gehen ans MC-Backend mit dem Jarvis-Agent
  # PBKDF2-Token (Boss-equivalente Scopes — siehe agents.scopes in DB).
  voice-worker:
    # Build context raised to the repo root (ADR-061) so the shared jarvis_core
    # package (sibling of voice_worker/) can be COPYied into the image. This
    # service is built locally only (not in the GHCR release matrix), so raising
    # the context is safe.
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: voice_worker/Dockerfile
    profiles: ["voice"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *default-logging
    depends_on:
      livekit:
        condition: service_healthy
      backend:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      LIVEKIT_URL: ${LIVEKIT_URL:-ws://livekit:7880}
      LIVEKIT_API_KEY: ${LIVEKIT_API_KEY:-}
      LIVEKIT_API_SECRET: ${LIVEKIT_API_SECRET:-}
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
      XAI_API_KEY: ${XAI_API_KEY:-}
      VOICE_PROVIDER: ${VOICE_PROVIDER:-openai}
      VOICE_MODEL: ${VOICE_MODEL:-gpt-realtime-2.1}
      # ADR-083: which wire api a (provider, model) pair speaks — "realtime"
      # or "live" (OpenAI gpt-live-1 full-duplex, needs the GPT-Live plugin
      # from livekit-plugins-openai >= 1.8.1) — is NOT a separate env var. It is derived
      # from the model name by jarvis_core.voice_provider.classify_voice_api
      # (one rule, shared with the backend's GET /api/v1/agent/voice/config
      # response), whether the model comes from the MC runtime binding
      # (ADR-082, normal case) or from VOICE_MODEL above (env fallback when
      # MC delivers nothing). An earlier version of this PR had a separate
      # VOICE_API var here — dropped as redundant with classify_voice_api,
      # which already covers the "VOICE_MODEL=gpt-live-1 but nothing marks
      # it as live" case that var existed for.
      #
      # Backend Responses model for GPT-Live delegation (api=live only),
      # separate from JARVIS_FRONTIER_MODEL below — Full-Duplex needs fast
      # answers, ask_frontier is allowed to think slowly. Default (unset)
      # falls back to gpt-5.6-luna (OpenAI's own GPT-Live "Fast mode"
      # default) — see voice_worker/main.py::_resolve_live_backend_model().
      JARVIS_LIVE_BACKEND_MODEL: ${JARVIS_LIVE_BACKEND_MODEL:-}
      # Jarvis Intelligence (ADR-062): frontier model + gate for the ask_frontier
      # tool (off by default → not offered in the voice tool schema).
      JARVIS_FRONTIER_MODEL: ${JARVIS_FRONTIER_MODEL:-}
      JARVIS_FRONTIER_ENABLED: ${JARVIS_FRONTIER_ENABLED:-false}
      JARVIS_AGENT_TOKEN: ${JARVIS_AGENT_TOKEN:-}
      # Siehe Backend-Service: Anzeigename des Operators + Proxy-Schalter.
      JARVIS_OPERATOR_USER_ID: ${JARVIS_OPERATOR_USER_ID:-}
      MC_BACKEND_URL: http://backend:8000
      # Env-Fallback, wenn MC keine Runtime-Bindung liefert (Backend down,
      # Agent unbounden) — jarvis_core.voice_provider faellt dann hierauf
      # zurueck statt zu verstummen (ADR-082). VOICE_VOICE_ID bleibt der
      # legacy provider-agnostische Fallback (galt frueher fuer beide Arme).
      VOICE_VOICE_ID: ${VOICE_VOICE_ID:-}
      VOICE_OPENAI_VOICE_ID: ${VOICE_OPENAI_VOICE_ID:-}
      VOICE_XAI_VOICE_ID: ${VOICE_XAI_VOICE_ID:-}

  # Dedicated CDP-exposing Chromium for the agent browser workflow. Replaces
  # playwright-mcp's internal browser so MC can attach a SECOND CDP session to
  # the same pages for the live screencast view (the internal browser runs
  # over --remote-debugging-pipe and is unreachable from outside).
  # Chromium binds its debug port to 127.0.0.1:9222 only (M113+ ignores
  # --remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0), so an in-container socat re-exposes it
  # on 0.0.0.0:9223 for other containers (playwright-mcp via CDP_BROWSER_URL).
  # socat lives INSIDE this image (docker/cdp-browser/) — not a standalone
  # cdp-socat sidecar — so it shares Chromium's exact lifecycle and can never
  # bind to a stale netns after a browser crash-loop (the old ECONNREFUSED bug).
  # omp agents (agent compose) are NOT on cdpnet: they reach this service by
  # name through a socat relay on 127.0.0.1 inside their own container (Host
  # header = IP, so Chromium accepts it) — see docker/omp-bridge/cdp-relay.sh.
  #
  # Port 9300 (same container, bauplan.md PR B1): `cdp-gateway` — an
  # agent-aware front door in front of Chromium's debug port. It answers the
  # same /json/* shapes as :9223 (PUT /json/new included) but also works out
  # which agent a connection belongs to — from the `/a/<slug>/` path prefix
  # the omp relay puts on every request (docker/omp-bridge/cdp_relay.py;
  # reverse DNS of the peer IP is only a last resort, it failed live) — and
  # which tab is whose (created, or claimed on use: omp reuses existing tabs).
  # `GET /mc/targets[?agent=<slug>]` lets the operator's per-agent browser
  # panel show only that agent's tabs; `agent: null` = not assigned to any
  # agent. :9223 (plain socat, no attribution) stays exactly as it is for
  # the backend's screencast path and playwright-mcp — whose tabs (shared by
  # every claude agent) therefore always show as "not assigned". No host
  # port published — internal to the compose network only, same as :9223.
  cdp-browser:
    build: ./docker/cdp-browser
    profiles: ["browser"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *default-logging
    # One Chromium serves every agent session (ADR-088): a runaway tab must not
    # eat the shared Docker VM. Idle it needs ~0.25-0.4 GB.
    mem_limit: 2g
    # Reaper as PID 1 (live finding 02.10.: 71 716 zombie `timeout` processes
    # after 14 days). The healthcheck's `timeout 5 websocat` outlives its shell,
    # gets re-parented to PID 1 — and Chromium never reaps. Zombies hold PIDs
    # from the Docker VM's SHARED pid space (pid_max 99 999), so this was a slow
    # fork bomb for every container. The entrypoint still execs Chromium, so its
    # exit still ends the container (restart policy unchanged).
    init: true
    networks:
      default: {}
      cdpnet:
        ipv4_address: 172.30.99.10
    command:
      - --no-sandbox
      - --headless=new
      - --disable-gpu
      # WebGL for agents (they verify 3D/canvas work with this browser). In
      # headless mode WebGL runs on SwiftShader (CPU). Chromium gives up on the
      # GPU process after 3 crashes and then reports getContext('webgl') = null
      # until the browser restarts — the live browser had logged 63 x "GPU
      # process exited unexpectedly" and an agent could never see its WebGL
      # scene (02.10.). Lift that limit; docker/cdp-browser/test_webgl.sh
      # kills the GPU process 4x and checks WebGL still renders.
      - --disable-gpu-process-crash-limit
      # Keeps the SwiftShader WebGL fallback: opt-in on current Chromium (154),
      # the safety net should --disable-gpu ever be dropped.
      - --enable-unsafe-swiftshader
      # A real window size for new tabs: the headless default was 780x493 on
      # Chromium 124 (the live panel showed a small picture with a border);
      # 1280x900 gives a 1280x813 page.
      - --window-size=1280,900
      - --disable-dev-shm-usage
      - --remote-debugging-port=9222
      - --remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0
      - --remote-allow-origins=*
      - about:blank
    healthcheck:
      # Real CDP roundtrip (HTTP /json/version + a WS Target.getTargets call),
      # not just HTTP — see docker/cdp-browser/healthcheck.sh for why. Incident
      # 2026-09-13: HTTP-only stayed "healthy" for 5 days while the WebSocket
      # path was wedged and every Playwright call hung at its 30s timeout.
      # timeout: 10s covers the script's own worst case (3s HTTP + 5s WS = 8s)
      # with margin, so Docker's own kill never fires before the script's.
      # start_period: 30s — the check now does two real round-trips instead
      # of one HTTP GET, so it's more likely to catch Chromium still coming
      # up right after container start. Cheap insurance against that being
      # mistaken for the wedge this check exists to find.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "/usr/local/bin/cdp-healthcheck.sh"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      start_period: 30s
      retries: 3

  # Playwright MCP Server (Sidecar) — replaces mc-playwright HTTP service for
  # agent-driven browser tests. Agents see screenshots inline as image content
  # in the MCP tool response (no more "blind" hallucination problem from the
  # 2026-04-23 visual-verify bug class). mc-playwright above stays for
  # CI-style automated reporting workflows.
  #
  # Connection from agents: http://playwright-mcp:8931/mcp (HTTP transport)
  # Image-Responses are enabled by default (--image-responses allow).
  playwright-mcp:
    # Thin image, exact npm version (docker/playwright-mcp/Dockerfile): no own
    # browser, attaches to cdp-browser. Was mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/mcp:latest.
    build: ./docker/playwright-mcp
    profiles: ["browser"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    # The router is PID 1 and starts up to 17 playwright-mcp children: an init
    # reaps them and forwards SIGTERM.
    init: true
    logging: *default-logging
    depends_on:
      - cdp-browser
    networks:
      - default
      - cdpnet
    # The entrypoint is the router (docker/playwright-mcp/router.mjs): one
    # playwright-mcp child per browser session (/s/<token>/mcp -> CDP over the
    # gateway's session address), per agent address (/a/<slug>/mcp) and the
    # unchanged shared one (/mcp -> the legacy endpoint). Its own flags come
    # first; everything after `--` is passed to every child. Since the
    # live-view feature the browser runs in cdp-browser; playwright-mcp never
    # launches its own.
    command: [
      "--listen", "8931",
      # Session and agent addresses go through cdp-gateway (it accepts the
      # service name as Host; Chromium itself only takes an IP — hence the
      # fixed cdpnet address for the legacy shared child).
      "--gateway", "http://cdp-browser:9300",
      "--legacy-cdp-endpoint", "http://172.30.99.10:9223",
      "--idle-minutes", "30",
      "--max-children", "16",
      "--",
      "--isolated",
      # Same size as the live panel shows it (Playwright's own default is 1280x720).
      "--viewport-size", "1280x800",
      # Output-Dir auf shared bind-mount damit Backend + Agents die Screenshots
      # als Files sehen koennen (und der Operator im UI). Convention: Agent ruft
      # browser_take_screenshot(filename="<task_id>/<descriptive>.png") auf,
      # Backend's mc deliverable from-mcp endpoint validiert + registriert.
      "--output-dir", "/output",
      # Allow agent containers to reach this server. We use '*' (no DNS-rebinding
      # protection) because the service is only on the internal docker network
      # and the entire stack trusts each other. If you ever expose this beyond
      # the docker network, switch to an explicit host list.
      "--allowed-hosts", "*"
    ]
    volumes:
      # Bind-mount nach ~/.mc/mcp-screenshots/ — folgt dem mc-Layout der
      # anderen Services (~/.mc/...). Backend mountet denselben Pfad als
      # /shared-mcp:ro damit `mc deliverable from-mcp` File-Existenz und
      # Inhalt verifizieren kann ohne Container-Boundary-Tricks.
      - ${HOME}/.mc/mcp-screenshots:/output
    healthcheck:
      # The router's own health (starts no playwright-mcp child).
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "node -e \"require('http').get('http://localhost:8931/healthz', r=>process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))\""]

      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  mc_redis_data:
  mc_qdrant_data:
  mc_shared_deliverables:
  caddy_data:
  caddy_config:

# ADR-023 ultrareview: explizit den Default-Network-Namen fixieren damit
# docker-compose.agents.yml ihn via `external: true` als
# `mission-control_default` auflösen kann, unabhängig vom COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME.
# Ohne das bricht der Agent-Stack wenn jemand das Repo umbenennt oder mit

repository.readme:
# 前沿科技日报 (ai-daily-v3)

AI 驱动的中文科技日报。约每 10 分钟抓取中外科技 RSS/AIHOT 源 → Kimi 翻译/摘要/分类 + 推断关联标的 → 自动部署。点新闻里的标的可看实时行情。

线上:https://ai-daily-v3.vercel.app

## 当前本机运行方式

生产抓取由本机 `com.steve.ai-daily-trigger` 定时任务每 10 分钟触发,入口为
`scripts/run_local_grok_update.py`。富化使用本地 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-8bit`
(`http://127.0.0.1:8799`),不调用 Kimi;下文 Kimi/Action 描述是备用运行方式。
数据入库后推送 GitHub,无需重新部署网页即可更新资讯。

模型接口不可用时,运行器会检查 `ai.local-mlx.qwen36.server`,恢复缺失或停止的服务,
最多等待 90 秒。不会重启正在运行的模型,不会启用被明确禁用的服务,
也不会修改自定义 `LOCAL_API_BASE` / `LOCAL_MODEL`。设置 `AID_MODEL_AUTOSTART=0`
可关闭自动恢复。机器需开机、保持用户登录且可联网。

历史补抓:先运行 `scripts/collect_news_history.py --start <带时区时间> --end <带时区时间> --output <manifest.json>`,
可用 `scripts/collect_sitemap_history.py <manifest.json>` 扩充月度归档。
再用 `scripts/enqueue_news_history.py <manifest.json>` 在抓取锁空闲时导入队列。
`backfill_queue.json` 跟随数据提交,定时任务每轮为历史候选保留 25 个名额
(`AID_BACKFILL_CAP` 可覆盖),其余继续抓最新资讯;无新资讯时可用满单轮上限。
历史队列按北京时间的日期轮流处理,避免高频来源让其他日期长时间空缺。
源材料必须含真实发布时间,已有链接不重复导入,临时失败交给现有重试队列。
`data/status.json.backfill` 记录进度;来源报告标记无法完整遍历的归档,不能把候选数当作入库数。

## 它自动做什么

GitHub Action(`.github/workflows/update-news.yml`,`cron: 7,17,27,37,47,57 * * * *`)：

```
fetch_rss.py 抓多路中外科技 RSS/AIHOT 源
  → enrich_news.py:
      · 按 URL 对 seen_urls.json 去重,只处理没见过的新条目
      · 每条调 Kimi(kimi-for-coding)→ 中文标题/摘要/正文 + 分类 + 标签 + 关联标的
      · 非科技/科学/前沿产业/地缘科技相关内容直接跳过
      · 单次最多富化 50 条(CAP);完整归档按时间倒序保留,不按分类条数淘汰;仅首页轻量列表限量
      · 生成今日综述 newsDigest
      · 写全量 news_data_latest.js + 前端轻量 news_data_list.js + news_bodies.json + news_chat_index.json
  → 抓到 <10 条则放弃(防覆盖)
  → 有新数据才 git push(前端从 GitHub raw 读最新数据;站点壳由 deploy-site 低频部署)
```

无新条目的批次:不改文件、不部署。

## 文件说明

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | 首页:今日综述卡 + 头条 + 推荐指数 + 分类信息流 + 内联搜索 |
| `detail.html` | 详情页:按需加载正文 + 关联标的 + 问AI |
| `stock.html` | 行情页:分批加载、按涨跌幅排序、市场筛选 |
| `assets/theme.css` | 设计系统(含暗色模式) |
| `assets/app.js` | 前端共享逻辑(封面、加载列表/正文、标的标签、问AI面板) |
| `fetch_rss.py` | RSS 抓取(纯标准库) |
| `enrich_news.py` | 抓取→去重→Kimi 富化→写拆分数据(管线主程序) |
| `api/quote.js` | Vercel serverless:代理新浪财经取实时行情 |
| `api/chat.js` | Vercel serverless:AI 对话(读轻量索引召回,按需网页检索) |
| `news_data_list.js` | **前端主数据**(无正文,近 14 天/最多 800 条);线上从 GitHub raw 拉取 |
| `news_bodies.json` | 详情页按需加载的正文映射 `{id: body}` |
| `news_chat_index.json` | 问AI 服务端召回索引 |
| `news_data_latest.js` | 全量归档(管线累计 + 兜底) |
| `seen_urls.json` | 去重用的已见 URL 清单(最多 5000) |
| `vercel.json` | 静态资源缓存策略 |

## 怎么改

- **加/删数据源**:`fetch_rss.py` 的 `FEEDS` 列表(每项 `(来源名, RSS地址, 默认分类)`)和 `fetch_aihot_items()`。每源取多少条改 `PER_FEED` / `AIHOT_TAKE`。
- **单次富化上限**:`enrich_news.py` 顶部 `CAP`(默认 50),可用 `AID_CAP` 覆盖。完整归档不淘汰旧文章,旧的 `AID_KEEP` 设置不再生效。
- **前端列表窗口**:`AID_FRONTEND_DAYS`(默认 14)、`AID_FRONTEND_MAX`(默认 800)、`AID_CHAT_INDEX_MAX`(默认 1500)。
- **历史浏览**:首页和分类可切换“近期 / 全部历史”;关键词、来源和日期筛选查询完整归档。日期输入和展示统一为北京时间,截止日期包含当天。
- **阅读状态**:筛选条件保存在 URL,列表分页和滚动位置保存在当前浏览器历史条目,进入详情后返回可继续阅读。
- **历史恢复**:`python3 scripts/restore_news_archive.py --ref <已审核的历史提交>` 默认只预览缺失条数;加 `--apply` 才恢复。与定时抓取共用锁,保留当前内容和历史 ID,不调用模型。恢复后需提交并发布数据。
- **更新健康状态**:来源失败、待重试或重试耗尽显示“部分异常”;管线错误显示“更新异常”;超过 25 分钟未检查显示“更新停滞”。
- **更新频率**:`.github/workflows/update-news.yml` 的 `cron`。
- **新闻富化模型**:`enrich_news.py` 默认 `ENRICH_PROVIDER=kimi`,使用 `KIMI_KEY` / `KIMI_MODEL=kimi-for-coding`;如需回退可设 `ENRICH_PROVIDER=qwen`。
- **问 AI 模型**:`api/chat.js` 生产默认 Kimi;Vercel 设 `CHAT_PROVIDER=qwen` 可回退 Qwen。
- **问 AI 口令**(可选):Vercel 设 `CHAT_TOKEN=你的口令`,前端可在控制台执行 `localStorage.setItem('chat_token','你的口令')`。
- **分类与封面配色**:`assets/app.js` 的 `CATS`;`enrich_news.py` 的 `CATEGORIES`(两处分类要一致)。

## 分类体系

一级分类控制在前沿科技主线内:

`人工智能`、`AI 基础设施`、`半导体与先进制造`、`机器人`、`商业航天`、`生物医药`、`量子科技`、`未来能源`、`新材料`、`脑机接口`、`网络安全`、`消费电子`、`地缘科技`。

`地缘科技`只收技术制裁、出口管制、国防科技、关键矿产、科技政策、供应链安全等科技相关议题,不收普通国际政治、体育、灾害和社会新闻。

## 实时行情

`stock.html?symbol=NVDA` → 调 `/api/quote?symbol=NVDA,0700.HK,600519.SH`(支持批量)。
- 数据源:新浪财经 `hq.sinajs.cn`(免费、无 key),serverless 内 GBK 解码、分 US/HK/CN 解析。
- 代码格式:美股直接代码(NVDA);港股 `0700.HK`;A股 `600519.SH` / `000001.SZ`。
- **时效**:A股/港股盘中接近实时,美股约延迟 15 分钟。新浪为非官方接口,若失效需换源。
- 红涨绿跌(中国习惯)。列表默认隐藏 `confidence: low` 的弱关联标的。

## AI 对话(问AI)

底栏「问AI」或详情「基于这篇提问」→ 前端 POST `{ question, focusId? }` 给 `/api/chat` → 服务端从 `news_chat_index.json` 召回,必要时做网页检索,再交给模型回答。
- 默认:`CHAT_PROVIDER=kimi`,走 Kimi Coding Plan。
- Qwen 回退:`CHAT_PROVIDER=qwen` + `QWEN_KEY`。
- 可选鉴权:`CHAT_TOKEN`;请求头需带 `x-chat-token`。
- ⚠️ 未设 `CHAT_TOKEN` 时端点公开,已有限流,仍会消耗模型 token。

## 部署 / Secrets

- 新闻数据:Action 推到 GitHub 后,前端/问AI 从 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 拉 `news_data_list.js` / `news_bodies.json` / `news_chat_index.json`。
- 站点壳:`.github/workflows/deploy-site.yml` 低频/手动 `vercel --prod`(main 的 git 自动部署已关)。
- 仓库 Secrets:`KIMI_KEY`、`QWEN_KEY`、`VERCEL_TOKEN`、`VERCEL_ORG_ID`、`VERCEL_PROJECT_ID`。
- Vercel 环境变量:`CHAT_PROVIDER=kimi`、`KIMI_KEY`;可选 `CHAT_TOKEN`。
- 本地手动部署:`npx vercel deploy --prod --token <VERCEL_TOKEN>`。

## 成本

抓取 / 调度(GitHub Action 公开仓库)/ 托管(Vercel)/ RSS / 新浪行情 —— 全免费。
唯一按量计费:Kimi/Qwen 模型调用(每批只富化新条目,无新闻的批次近 0)。

## 已知限制

- 强制每条出利好标的 → 个别关联偏弱(前端默认隐藏 low,详情可展开)。
- 新浪行情非官方接口,稳定性不保证。
- `/api/chat` 建议配置 `CHAT_TOKEN` 防刷。
- 部分小众分类条目偏少,靠累计逐步填充。

- **时效**:A股/港股盘中接近实时,美股约延迟 15 分钟。新浪为非官方接口,若失效需换源。
- 红涨绿跌(中国习惯)。列表默认隐藏 `confidence: low` 的弱关联标的。

## AI 对话(问AI)

底栏「问AI」或详情「基于这篇提问」→ 前端 POST `{ question, focusId? }` 给 `/api/chat` → 服务端从 `news_chat_index.json` 召回,必要时做网页检索,再交给模型回答。
- 默认:`CHAT_PROVIDER=kimi`,走 Kimi Coding Plan。
- Qwen 回退:`CHAT_PROVIDER=qwen` + `QWEN_KEY`。
- 可选鉴权:`CHAT_TOKEN`;请求头需带 `x-chat-token`。
- ⚠️ 未设 `CHAT_TOKEN` 时端点公开,已有限流,仍会消耗模型 token。

## 部署 / Secrets

- 新闻数据:Action 推到 GitHub 后,前端/问AI 从 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 拉 `news_data_list.js` / `news_bodies.json` / `news_chat_index.json`。
- 站点壳:`.github/workflows/deploy-site.yml` 低频/手动 `vercel --prod`(main 的 git 自动部署已关)。
- 仓库 Secrets:`KIMI_KEY`、`QWEN_KEY`、`VERCEL_TOKEN`、`VERCEL_ORG_ID`、`VERCEL_PROJECT_ID`。
- Vercel 环境变量:`CHAT_PROVIDER=kimi`、`KIMI_KEY`;可选 `CHAT_TOKEN`。
- 本地手动部署:`npx vercel deploy --prod --token <VERCEL_TOKEN>`。

## 成本

抓取 / 调度(GitHub Action 公开仓库)/ 托管(Vercel)/ RSS / 新浪行情 —— 全免费。
唯一按量计费:Kimi/Qwen 模型调用(每批只富化新条目,无新闻的批次近 0)。

## 已知限制

- 强制每条出利好标的 → 个别关联偏弱(前端默认隐藏 low,详情可展开)。
- 新浪行情非官方接口,稳定性不保证。
- `/api/chat` 建议配置 `CHAT_TOKEN` 防刷。
- 部分小众分类条目偏少,靠累计逐步填充。

repository.readme: # Mac MCP **Let your AI apps use your Mac.** Mac MCP is a local server and menu bar app that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode and other MCP apps work in your Mac's apps, files, terminal and browser, with approvals you control. It is for people who already work with an AI app and want it to act on their Mac, not just talk about it. - **It works inside your apps.** Your AI app opens Notes, looks through a folder in Finder or drafts a reply in Mail through macOS Accessibility, using the same buttons and menus you do. Files and the terminal are there too. - **It browses where you can see it.** Visible, non-focus-stealing browser automation in Safari and Chrome: it works in a tab while you keep using your Mac, and frames the tab so you can see what it touches. - **It hands off work and reports back.** Delegate a task to Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or one of seven other agent CLIs and read a report of what it did. - **It answers from your documents.** Pick folders in Settings › Privacy and your AI app can ask what your contracts, invoices or notes say, and get the file and page back. The index stays on your Mac. - **It automates the repeat work.** Scheduled Tasks run AI tasks and scripts on their own; Recipes save a job your AI did once and replay it with one click, from Settings, the Shortcuts app or Siri. [Watch the 40-second demo](site/assets/media/mac-mcp-demo.mp4) · Website: [bulutarkan.github.io/mac-mcp](https://bulutarkan.github.io/mac-mcp/) · [Install](docs/install.md#install) · MIT **Quick install:** download the `.pkg` from the [latest release](https://github.com/bulutarkan/mac-mcp/releases/latest) (Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later), or run the installer on any Mac with macOS 13 or later: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulutarkan/mac-mcp/main/install.sh | bash ``` or with Node.js: `npx @bulutarkan/mac-mcp install` (the same installer, [details](docs/install.md#npm-macos-13-apple-silicon-or-intel)). **You stay in charge.** Permission profiles decide what may run and optional Server Approval asks before risky actions; you can pause observation, turn on private mode, or keep apps and sites out of reach. Mac MCP is not a sandbox: it acts with your macOS user's permissions, localhost is machine-local transport, not same-user isolation, and what your AI app reads is sent to that app's provider. See [Product and security terminology](docs/safety.md#product-and-security-terminology). ## What's new in 2.2.0 2.2.0 lets your AI work on a schedule and shows what it is doing while it works. - **Scheduled Tasks:** AI tasks and scripts that run once, daily, weekly, monthly or every few hours, with a run report (result and steps) for each run. Tasks an AI app suggests wait for your approval in Settings. - **Live activity island:** an optional island beside the notch shows the app in use while your AI works, what needs you, recent work and the next scheduled task. Off by default (Settings › Activity & Notifications). - **Safer outgoing data:** the secret-egress guard also catches secrets hidden in base64, hex or percent-encoded payloads. **New in 2.2.0 r2** (the version stays 2.2.0; `mac-mcp update` or the new package brings it): - **Agent cursor on the desktop:** when an agent clicks or types in another app's window in the background, a cursor shows where, without moving yours. It sits with that window, so whatever you have in front covers it, and it never appears in screenshots. On by default (Settings › Activity & Notifications). - **Session details:** each session in the menu shows how long it has been open and how many tool calls it made; click it for a small panel with its status and current tool. - **Seven more AI apps and agents:** Antigravity, pi, Cline, Kilo Code, Goose, Kimi Code and Grok Build can be connected as AI apps and turned on as delegated agents. - **Whole pages in one call:** the browser `read` action returns a page's full text, including content that loads as you scroll. - **A CLI with a look of its own:** `mac-mcp`, `status`, `doctor` and the other commands line up their facts and end with one sentence and the next command to run; scripts and the menu app get the plain output as before. - **A new Mac MCP mark** on the app icon, the menu bar, the island, the site and the mobile page. Earlier releases are in the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md). ## Choose your path - **[Connect your AI apps](docs/connect.md):** Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode and other MCP apps, plus a public address for ChatGPT. - **[Install, update and permissions](docs/install.md):** requirements, the package and the installer, a manual install, updates and macOS permissions. - **[Browser work](docs/browser.md):** Safari and Chrome tabs without taking over your Mac, saved logins, privacy controls and the Visual Companion. - **[Safety, permissions and undo](docs/safety.md):** what the security words mean, permission profiles, Server Approval and file undo. - **[The menu bar app](docs/menu-app.md):** installing it and what the menu shows. - **[Agents and Scheduled Tasks](docs/agents-and-tasks.md):** delegating to Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and seven other agents, and running tasks on a schedule; recipes are in the [developer reference](docs/reference.md). - **[Developer reference](docs/reference.md):** the MCP and REST surfaces, server commands, voice, the dashboard and tool coverage. - Configuration, security details and terminology: [CONFIGURATION](docs/CONFIGURATION.md), [Local API security](docs/LOCAL_API_SECURITY.md), [Security assurance](docs/security-assurance.md), [TERMINOLOGY](docs/TERMINOLOGY.md). ## Agent Skills sync Mac MCP's `skill_list`, `skill_search`, and `skill_get` automatically discover user-level Agent Skills installed for CLI agents (including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Kimi, Pi, Kilo, Cline, and Goose) as well as the skills in `~/.mac-mcp/skills`. The shared `~/.agents/skills` folder is preferred over agent-specific duplicates, explicitly registered paths come next, and Mac MCP's own managed skills take final precedence on a name collision. No source files are copied or changed. The catalog refreshes when a skill tool is called: installing, editing, or removing a CLI skill is reflected on the next request without manually importing it or restarting the server. It indexes `SKILL.md` only from direct child folders of supported user-level directories; project-local skills are not imported. Set `MAC_MCP_CLI_SKILLS_DIRS` to a colon-separated list of global skills directories to override discovery, or to an empty string to disable it. When `MAC_MCP_SKILLS_DIR` is set for an isolated/custom instance, CLI discovery is off unless explicitly configured. ## Install **Package (Apple Silicon, macOS 14+):** download `Mac-MCP-…-arm64.pkg` from the [latest GitHub Release](https://github.com/bulutarkan/mac-mcp/releases/latest) and open it. It installs the menu bar app and the server for your account and starts them; nothing else is needed. It is not notarized yet, so the first open needs System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. **Installer (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon or Intel):** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulutarkan/mac-mcp/main/install.sh | bash ``` Then connect your AI app ([Connect your AI apps](docs/connect.md)). A manual install, updates and permissions are in [Install, update and permissions](docs/install.md). ## Contributing and security Contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the development and pull request workflow. Use the GitHub issue forms for bugs and feature requests, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for private vulnerability reporting, and see [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) for community expectations. ## Development Run tests: ```bash python -m unittest discover -s tests -v ``` Build the native menu app without installing it: ```bash ./menu_app/build_app.sh /tmp/mac-mcp-build ``` Project layout: ```text mcp_server/ Python MCP server and dashboard menu_app/ Native SwiftUI menu bar controller tests/ Regression tests openapi/ REST/OpenAPI schema assets ``` ## License MIT

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=69", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "mac-mcp"
version = "2.2.0"
description = "Local macOS control server for MCP clients and Custom GPT Actions"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "Tarkan Bulut" }]
dependencies = [
  "fastapi==0.141.1",
  "starlette==1.6.0",
  "uvicorn[standard]==0.32.1",
  "httpx==0.28.1",
  "python-dotenv==1.2.3",
  "mcp[cli]==1.28.1",
  "fastembed==0.8.0",
  "PyYAML==6.0.3",
  "edge-tts==7.2.8"
]

[project.scripts]
mac-mcp = "mcp_server.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools]
packages = ["mcp_server"]
include-package-data = true

[tool.mypy]
# Gradual type checking (#145): modules with clean, stable interfaces. Add a module here
# once it passes; CI runs plain `mypy` with this configuration.
python_version = "3.10"
files = [
  "mcp_server/applescript_host.py",
  "mcp_server/browser_sign_in.py",
  "mcp_server/data_guard.py",
  "mcp_server/login_vault.py",
  "mcp_server/perception.py",
  "mcp_server/process_supervision.py",
  "mcp_server/scoped_fs.py",
  "mcp_server/swift_build.py",
  "mcp_server/tool_cancellation.py",
]
follow_imports = "silent"
ignore_missing_imports = true
check_untyped_defs = true
warn_unused_ignores = true
warn_redundant_casts = true

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
mcp_server = ["*.swift", "vendor/*.js", "browser_js/*.js", "dashboard/*.html", "dashboard/*.css", "dashboard/*.js", "mobile/*.html", "mobile/*.css", "mobile/*.js", "mobile/*.json", "chatgpt_ui/*.html", "release_trusted_signers.txt"]

repository.readme:
# kordoc

**모두 파싱해버리겠다.**

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/kordoc.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/kordoc)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/kordoc.svg)](LICENSE)

> *대한민국에서 둘째가라면 서러울 문서지옥. 거기서 7년 버틴 공무원이 만들었습니다.*

HWP 3.x·5.x, HWPX, HWPML, PDF, XLS·XLSX, DOCX, PPTX, PNG·JPG·WebP를 Markdown과 구조화 데이터로 변환합니다. 라이브러리·CLI·MCP 서버로 사용할 수 있습니다.

[English](README-EN.md) · [상세 사용법](docs/usage.md) · [벤치마크](docs/benchmarks.md) · [변경 이력](CHANGELOG.md)

- 📊 **PDF 공개 벤치 종합 0.963** — opendataloader-bench 200문서. 공개 12개 파서 비교 1위(2026-09-29 기록). [측정 조건](docs/benchmarks.md)
- 🇰🇷 **한국 공문서 표 구조 100%** — 원본 HWPX 2,429문서의 보이는 표 **10,461개 전부 구조 일치**. [4.22.0 검증](docs/benchmarks.md)

쓸모 있었다면 GitHub ⭐ 하나 눌러주세요. 다른 사람이 이 도구를 찾는 데 도움이 됩니다.

[![Kordoc 활용하기 — 영상 보기](./docs/video-demo.jpg)](https://youtu.be/Q13GmgDcIw0)

<sub>▶ 클릭하면 유튜브에서 재생됩니다.</sub>

**새 영상:** [kordoc 공개벤치 1위 마크](https://youtu.be/9kRbwiTRQLs) · 2026-09-27 · 1분 31초

## 설치

Node.js **20 이상** · macOS / Linux / Windows

```bash
npm install kordoc
```

CLI는 설치 없이 `npx kordoc`으로 실행할 수 있습니다. PDF·OCR 의존성은 기본 설치되며, `--omit=optional`로 제외하면 해당 기능이 제한됩니다.

**AI 에이전트에 연결**

```bash
npx -y kordoc setup
```

Claude Desktop·Claude Code·Cursor·Codex 등 설치된 클라이언트에 MCP를 등록합니다. 클라이언트를 재시작하면 파싱·비교·생성·렌더 등 **17개 도구**를 사용할 수 있습니다.

Claude Code 플러그인:

```text
/plugin marketplace add chrisryugj/kordoc
/plugin install kordoc@kordoc
```

[수동 MCP 등록과 설치 문제 해결](docs/usage.md)

## 빠른 시작

### CLI

```bash
npx kordoc 문서.hwpx -o 문서.md
npx kordoc *.pdf --jobs 4 -d ./결과
npx kordoc 문서.pdf --format json --pages 1-3
npx kordoc 스캔본.pdf --ocr -o 스캔본.md
npx kordoc generate 보고서.md --preset 보고서 -o 보고서.hwpx
npx kordoc fill --template gian -j 값.json -o 기안문.hwpx
```

`--jobs`는 파일 단위 병렬 변환이며 메모리 사용도 늘어납니다. [병렬 변환 안내](docs/parallel-batch.md)

보고서·계획서·개조식·서울방침은 `#` 제목 바로 뒤 인용문(`> …하고자 함`)이 요약 상자가 됩니다(개조식은 표지가 있을 때(기본) 본문 첫 쪽 제목 상자 아래 — `cover:false` 면 첫 `#` 이 장 머리라 인용문은 ※ 참고). 보고 목적 한 문장(쉼표 허용) 3줄 이내로 쓰고, 넘거나 두 문장 이상이면 경고합니다. 업무보고는 `> ▪ …` 인용문이 자리와 관계없이 성과 요약 상자가 됩니다.

### JavaScript / TypeScript

```typescript
import { parse, markdownToHwpx } from "kordoc"
import { writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"

const result = await parse("문서.hwpx")
if (result.success) {
  console.log(result.markdown)
  // result.blocks: 구조화 데이터, result.metadata: 문서 정보
}

const hwpx = await markdownToHwpx("# 추진계획\n\n본문", {
  gongmun: { preset: "보고서" },
})
await writeFile("보고서.hwpx", Buffer.from(hwpx))
```

[파싱 옵션·API·양식·렌더 예제](docs/usage.md#-빠른-시작)

## 주요 기능

| 작업 | 기능 |
| --- | --- |
| 읽기 | 문서 → Markdown·IR·쪽별 본문·RAG 청크, 로컬 OCR |
| 비교·편집 | 블록·셀 단위 비교, HWPX·HWP 서식 보존 패치 |
| 작성 | Markdown → HWPX, 공문서 프리셋, 표·수식·차트 |
| 양식 | 필드·누름틀 채우기, 표준 기안문 2종, 도장 날인 |
| 검토 | HWPX·HWP 미리보기·영역 추출, 구조·표기법 검사, 개인정보 마스킹 |

서식 보존 패치용 Markdown은 `--keep-layout-tables`로 추출합니다. 적용하지 못한 편집은 건너뛴 사유로 보고합니다. [CLI·API 상세](docs/usage.md#-cli)

## 검증 결과

**4.22.7 · 2026-10-18 검증**. 고정 코퍼스와 참조 기준으로 측정한 결과입니다.

| 대상 | 규모 | 결과 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HWPX | 2,424문서 · 10,342표 | 표 구조 일치 **10,342/10,342 · 100%** |
| HWP 5.x ↔ HWPX | 1,130쌍 · 4,315표 | 짝 문서의 표 구조 일치 **100%** |
| PDF 글 | 744쌍 | 글자 재현율 **99.879%** · 정확도 **99.670%** · 읽기 순서 **99.247%** · 어절 F1 **99.049%** |
| PDF 표 | 708쌍 · 2,331표 | 표 탐지 **99.87%** · 구조 일치 **98.16%** · 칸 F1 **0.9918** |
| HWPX 재조판 | 다중줄 25,187문단 (12개 폴더) | 모든 줄 시작 일치 **24,938/25,187 · 99.01%** |
| PDF 중첩표 (텍스트층) | 29문서 · 101표 | 구조·칸 내용 **101/101 · 100%** |
| 법령 별표 | 272건 · 346표 | HWP **346/346**, PDF **342/346 · 98.84%** |
| PDF 전체 | 1,911문서 중 1,729건 채점 | 글 커버리지 **99.80%** |
| OCR | 53문서 · 102쪽 | CER **0.0409** · 글자 재현율 **99.02%** |

표 구조 점수와 셀 내용·화면 재현은 별도 지표입니다. 중첩표 100%는 위 101표에 한정하며 전체 PDF·조판의 완전 일치를 뜻하지 않습니다. 채점 범위·제외 기준·전 벤치 문서별 비교는 [벤치마크 상세](docs/benchmarks.md)에 있습니다.

**4.22.7 개선 검증(2026-10-18)**: 4.22.6과 같은 채점기·코퍼스로 다시 잰 결과 opendataloader-bench 기본값 종합 **0.96291→0.96305**(8문서 상승, 하락 0), 조판(12개 폴더 저장본 대조) 본문 첫 줄 위치 **76,525→76,631/78,375문단**, 표 칸 첫 줄 위치 **204,958→205,005/205,305**로 개선했습니다. 단어 안 밑줄과 빈칸 선(`성명: ______`)의 불필요한 마크다운 이스케이프를 걷고, 쪽에서 갈리는 표의 위·아래 캡션과 문단 위 여백, 한글 2024 초기 빌드의 글머리표 공백 압축을 한컴 저장본에 맞췄습니다. 다른 벤치는 문서별로 같습니다. [상세](docs/benchmarks.md)

빈 행을 접을 때 기존 논리 격자 안의 병합 모서리 셀을 보존합니다. 재현 PDF의 번호 기호 6종은 복원했으며, HTML 선 출력과 미등록 글꼴 기호는 [남은 한계](docs/parsing-loss-reproductions.md)로 기록했습니다.

외부 PDF 벤치 **opendataloader-bench 200문서**는 4.22.7 배포 후보의 동일 코퍼스 재검증에서 기본값 종합 **0.963**, OCR 끔 **0.939**입니다. [옵션별 결과와 재현 방법](docs/benchmarks.md#pdf--markdown--opendataloader-bench)

버전별 상세는 [변경 이력](CHANGELOG.md)에 있습니다.

## 자주 묻는 질문

**Q. HWP·HWPX 파일을 Markdown으로 바꾸려면?**
`npx kordoc 문서.hwp -o 문서.md` 한 줄입니다. 한컴오피스 없이 파일을 직접 읽으며, 여러 파일은 `npx kordoc *.hwpx -d ./output`으로 한 번에 바꿉니다.

**Q. Claude·Cursor 같은 AI가 한글 문서를 읽게 하려면?**
`npx -y kordoc setup`으로 MCP를 등록하면 AI가 파일 경로만 받아 HWP·PDF·엑셀을 읽고, 비교하고, 양식을 채웁니다.

**Q. 인터넷이 막힌 폐쇄망에서도 되나요?**
됩니다. `KORDOC_OFFLINE=1`이 외부 통신을 모두 막고, OCR도 API 키 없이 로컬 CPU에서 돕니다. [폐쇄망 설치](docs/offline-deployment.md)

**Q. RAG 색인용으로 쓸 수 있나요?**
`--format chunks`가 제목 경로를 붙인 구조 청크와 독립 표 청크를 냅니다. 표를 HTML 없이 받으려면 `--table-format gfm`(API는 `tableFormat: "gfm"`)을 씁니다. Python·Java에서는 [Python SDK](sdk/python/README.md)·[Java SDK](sdk/java/README.md)로 부릅니다.

## 문서·보안

- [상세 사용법](docs/usage.md): 전체 CLI·MCP 도구·API·지원 포맷
- [Java SDK](sdk/java/README.md) · [Python SDK](sdk/python/README.md): 상주 엔진 워커로 Java·Python 시스템에서 파싱 ([워커 프로토콜](docs/parse-worker-protocol.md))
- [공문서 생성 가이드](docs/gongmunseo-engine-spec.md) · [아키텍처](docs/architecture.md)
- [폐쇄망 설치](docs/offline-deployment.md): `KORDOC_OFFLINE=1`, MCP 접근 범위 `KORDOC_ROOT`
- [보안 정책](SECURITY.md) · [라이선스 MIT](LICENSE) · [오픈소스 고지](NOTICE)

## 만든 사람

대한민국 지방공무원. 광진구청에서 7년간 HWP 파일과 싸우다가 이걸 만들었습니다. 5개 공공 프로젝트에서 수천 건의 실제 관공서 문서를 파싱하며 검증했습니다.

name: Test and Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20, 22, 24]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
        env:
          # onnxruntime-node 설치 스크립트의 CUDA 바이너리(api.nuget.org)는 CPU 추론에 필요 없다. 다운로드 타임아웃으로
          # npm ci 가 실패하던 것(2026-09-23 두 번 연속) 방지
          ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL: skip
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build

  # Java·Python SDK — Node 24 로 한 번 빌드한 dist/ 를 두 SDK 잡이 artifact 로 받아 쓴다(기존 Node 매트릭스와 분리)
  engine-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
        env:
          ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL: skip
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: engine-dist
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 1

  python-sdk:
    needs: engine-dist
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # 지원 하한과 최신 — 3.14 는 run_coroutine_threadsafe 가 첫 걸음 전 취소를 바로 건다(동기 close 를 Ctrl-C 로 끊는 경로)
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python: ["3.11", "3.14"]
    env:
      KORDOC_CLI: ${{ github.workspace }}/dist/cli.js
      KORDOC_SDK_FIXTURES: ${{ github.workspace }}/.sdk-fixtures
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      # 엔진 실행 의존성 + 합성 문서 생성(tsx)
      - run: npm ci
        env:
          ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL: skip
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: engine-dist
          path: dist/
      - run: node --import tsx tests/fixtures/sdk-docs.ts "$KORDOC_SDK_FIXTURES"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - name: 테스트 (실제 엔진·Node parse() 결과 동등성·장애 주입)
        working-directory: sdk/python
        run: |
          python -m pip install -e '.[test]'
          python -m pytest -W error::pytest.PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning
      # wheel 이 돌아도 sdist 가 깨질 수 있어 둘 다 설치해 본다
      - name: wheel·sdist 를 각각 빈 가상환경에서 설치해 실제 파싱
        working-directory: sdk/python
        run: |
          python -m build -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/pydist"
          for dist in whl tar.gz; do
            python -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/consume-$dist"
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/consume-$dist/bin/pip" install "$RUNNER_TEMP"/pydist/kordoc-*."$dist"
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/consume-$dist/bin/python" examples/parse_document.py "$KORDOC_SDK_FIXTURES/중첩 표.hwpx" --gfm | grep -q '<!-- <table id="t1" /> -->'
          done

  java-sdk:
    needs: engine-dist
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      KORDOC_CLI: ${{ github.workspace }}/dist/cli.js
      KORDOC_SDK_FIXTURES: ${{ github.workspace }}/.sdk-fixtures
      # JVM 이 한국어 파일 경로를 다루려면 UTF-8 locale 이 필요하다
      LANG: C.UTF-8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
        env:
          ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL: skip
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: engine-dist
          path: dist/
      - run: node --import tsx tests/fixtures/sdk-docs.ts "$KORDOC_SDK_FIXTURES"
      - uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
          cache: maven
      - name: 테스트·JAR·sources JAR (실제 엔진·Node parse() 결과 동등성·장애 주입)
        run: mvn -B -f sdk/java/pom.xml install
      - name: 별도 Maven 예제가 설치한 JAR 로 실제 파싱
        run: |
          mvn -B -q -f sdk/java/examples/consumer/consumer-pom.xml compile exec:java -Dexec.args="'$KORDOC_SDK_FIXTURES/중첩 표.hwpx' --gfm" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-example.md"
          grep -q '<!-- <table id="t1" /> -->' "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-example.md"

# kordoc

**모두 파싱해버리겠다.**

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/kordoc.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/kordoc)

> *대한민국에서 둘째가라면 서러울 문서지옥. 거기서 7년 버틴 공무원이 만들었습니다.*

## 설치

Node.js **20 이상** · macOS / Linux / Windows

```bash
npm install kordoc
```

CLI는 설치 없이 `npx kordoc`으로 실행할 수 있습니다. PDF·OCR 의존성은 기본 설치되며, `--omit=optional`로 제외하면 해당 기능이 제한됩니다.

**AI 에이전트에 연결**

```bash
npx -y kordoc setup
```

Claude Desktop·Claude Code·Cursor·Codex 등 설치된 클라이언트에 MCP를 등록합니다. 클라이언트를 재시작하면 파싱·비교·생성·렌더 등 **17개 도구**를 사용할 수 있습니다.

Claude Code 플러그인:

```text
/plugin marketplace add chrisryugj/kordoc
/plugin install kordoc@kordoc
```

[수동 MCP 등록과 설치 문제 해결](docs/usage.md)

## 빠른 시작

### CLI

```bash
npx kordoc 문서.hwpx -o 문서.md
npx kordoc *.pdf --jobs 4 -d ./결과
npx kordoc 문서.pdf --format json --pages 1-3
npx kordoc 스캔본.pdf --ocr -o 스캔본.md
npx kordoc generate 보고서.md --preset 보고서 -o 보고서.hwpx
npx kordoc fill --template gian -j 값.json -o 기안문.hwpx
```

`--jobs`는 파일 단위 병렬 변환이며 메모리 사용도 늘어납니다. [병렬 변환 안내](docs/parallel-batch.md)

보고서·계획서·개조식·서울방침은 `#` 제목 바로 뒤 인용문(`> …하고자 함`)이 요약 상자가 됩니다(개조식은 표지가 있을 때(기본) 본문 첫 쪽 제목 상자 아래 — `cover:false` 면 첫 `#` 이 장 머리라 인용문은 ※ 참고). 보고 목적 한 문장(쉼표 허용) 3줄 이내로 쓰고, 넘거나 두 문장 이상이면 경고합니다. 업무보고는 `> ▪ …` 인용문이 자리와 관계없이 성과 요약 상자가 됩니다.

### JavaScript / TypeScript

```typescript
import { parse, markdownToHwpx } from "kordoc"
import { writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"

const result = await parse("문서.hwpx")
if (result.success) {
  console.log(result.markdown)
  // result.blocks: 구조화 데이터, result.metadata: 문서 정보
}

const hwpx = await markdownToHwpx("# 추진계획\n\n본문", {
  gongmun: { preset: "보고서" },
})
await writeFile("보고서.hwpx", Buffer.from(hwpx))
```

## 주요 기능

| 작업 | 기능 |
| --- | --- |
| 읽기 | 문서 → Markdown·IR·쪽별 본문·RAG 청크, 로컬 OCR |
| 비교·편집 | 블록·셀 단위 비교, HWPX·HWP 서식 보존 패치 |
| 작성 | Markdown → HWPX, 공문서 프리셋, 표·수식·차트 |
| 양식 | 필드·누름틀 채우기, 표준 기안문 2종, 도장 날인 |
| 검토 | HWPX·HWP 미리보기·영역 추출, 구조·표기법 검사, 개인정보 마스킹 |

서식 보존 패치용 Markdown은 `--keep-layout-tables`로 추출합니다. 적용하지 못한 편집은 건너뛴 사유로 보고합니다. [CLI·API 상세](docs/usage.md#-cli)

## 검증 결과

**4.22.7 · 2026-10-18 검증**. 고정 코퍼스와 참조 기준으로 측정한 결과입니다.

| 대상 | 규모 | 결과 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HWPX | 2,424문서 · 10,342표 | 표 구조 일치 **10,342/10,342 · 100%** |
| HWP 5.x ↔ HWPX | 1,130쌍 · 4,315표 | 짝 문서의 표 구조 일치 **100%** |
| PDF 글 | 744쌍 | 글자 재현율 **99.879%** · 정확도 **99.670%** · 읽기 순서 **99.247%** · 어절 F1 **99.049%** |
| PDF 표 | 708쌍 · 2,331표 | 표 탐지 **99.87%** · 구조 일치 **98.16%** · 칸 F1 **0.9918** |
| HWPX 재조판 | 다중줄 25,187문단 (12개 폴더) | 모든 줄 시작 일치 **24,938/25,187 · 99.01%** |
| PDF 중첩표 (텍스트층) | 29문서 · 101표 | 구조·칸 내용 **101/101 · 100%** |
| 법령 별표 | 272건 · 346표 | HWP **346/346**, PDF **342/346 · 98.84%** |
| PDF 전체 | 1,911문서 중 1,729건 채점 | 글 커버리지 **99.80%** |
| OCR | 53문서 · 102쪽 | CER **0.0409** · 글자 재현율 **99.02%** |

표 구조 점수와 셀 내용·화면 재현은 별도 지표입니다. 중첩표 100%는 위 101표에 한정하며 전체 PDF·조판의 완전 일치를 뜻하지 않습니다. 채점 범위·제외 기준·전 벤치 문서별 비교는 [벤치마크 상세](docs/benchmarks.md)에 있습니다.

**4.22.7 개선 검증(2026-10-18)**: 4.22.6과 같은 채점기·코퍼스로 다시 잰 결과 opendataloader-bench 기본값 종합 **0.96291→0.96305**(8문서 상승, 하락 0), 조판(12개 폴더 저장본 대조) 본문 첫 줄 위치 **76,525→76,631/78,375문단**, 표 칸 첫 줄 위치 **204,958→205,005/205,305**로 개선했습니다. 단어 안 밑줄과 빈칸 선(`성명: ______`)의 불필요한 마크다운 이스케이프를 걷고, 쪽에서 갈리는 표의 위·아래 캡션과 문단 위 여백, 한글 2024 초기 빌드의 글머리표 공백 압축을 한컴 저장본에 맞췄습니다. 다른 벤치는 문서별로 같습니다. [상세](docs/benchmarks.md)

빈 행을 접을 때 기존 논리 격자 안의 병합 모서리 셀을 보존합니다. 재현 PDF의 번호 기호 6종은 복원했으며, HTML 선 출력과 미등록 글꼴 기호는 [남은 한계](docs/parsing-loss-reproductions.md)로 기록했습니다.

외부 PDF 벤치 **opendataloader-bench 200문서**는 4.22.7 배포 후보의 동일 코퍼스 재검증에서 기본값 종합 **0.963**, OCR 끔 **0.939**입니다. [옵션별 결과와 재현 방법](docs/benchmarks.md#pdf--markdown--opendataloader-bench)

## 자주 묻는 질문

**Q. HWP·HWPX 파일을 Markdown으로 바꾸려면?**
`npx kordoc 문서.hwp -o 문서.md` 한 줄입니다. 한컴오피스 없이 파일을 직접 읽으며, 여러 파일은 `npx kordoc *.hwpx -d ./output`으로 한 번에 바꿉니다.

**Q. Claude·Cursor 같은 AI가 한글 문서를 읽게 하려면?**
`npx -y kordoc setup`으로 MCP를 등록하면 AI가 파일 경로만 받아 HWP·PDF·엑셀을 읽고, 비교하고, 양식을 채웁니다.

**Q. 인터넷이 막힌 폐쇄망에서도 되나요?**
됩니다. `KORDOC_OFFLINE=1`이 외부 통신을 모두 막고, OCR도 API 키 없이 로컬 CPU에서 돕니다. [폐쇄망 설치](docs/offline-deployment.md)

**Q. RAG 색인용으로 쓸 수 있나요?**
`--format chunks`가 제목 경로를 붙인 구조 청크와 독립 표 청크를 냅니다. 표를 HTML 없이 받으려면 `--table-format gfm`(API는 `tableFormat: "gfm"`)을 씁니다. Python·Java에서는 [Python SDK](sdk/python/README.md)·[Java SDK](sdk/java/README.md)로 부릅니다.

repository.name: BRO-Personal-Ai
repository.readme:
Open the live desk · Source

# BRO BRO is a personal AI command desk. The public page on GitHub Pages reads live data in the browser and answers through a free router. It does not send trades, it does not hold API keys, and it does not pretend a local rule is a cloud model. This repository is the static desk. A fuller command centre, with an xAI queen, a signing gate, and a model roster, can run on a server. That server is not what GitHub Pages hosts. The pages below say which surface does which job, so a reader can tell a live fetch from a label. Built by [CodesbyFebin](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin). ## Live desk The published page is [codesbyfebin.github.io/bro](https://codesbyfebin.github.io/bro/). On load it does four things: 1. It reads the clock in the browser. 2. It asks the public GitHub API for the latest repositories under CodesbyFebin. 3. It asks Dexscreener for ORE and SOL, and Coinbase for the USDC spot. 4. It waits. Nothing is sent until you press Ask or Sync. Sync repeats the GitHub and mark fetch. Ask posts one short prompt to the anonymous free router. If that router answers `402`, the page says the free tier allows about one reply every 30 seconds. It does not invent a reply. The crew lines on the page are computed from those marks. Watch names the ORE print. Thesis says whether ORE is the red sleeve. Neither line is an order. ## What this repository contains | Path | Role | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | The desk, one file, no build step | | `assets/hero.jpg` | The banner at the top of this README | | `.nojekyll` | Stops GitHub Pages from running Jekyll on the file | There is no package manager, no bundler, and no secret in the tree. You can open `index.html` from disk. The fetches still need a network. The same file is also copied to `docs/bro/index.html` on [codesbyfebin.github.io](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/codesbyfebin.github.io), because that site publishes from its `docs` folder. This repository is the source you edit. The user site is the host that is already switched on. ## What is live These calls leave the browser. They use public endpoints. They do not use a token from this repo. **GitHub.** `GET https://api.github.com/users/CodesbyFebin/repos?sort=updated&per_page=6`. The page lists the name, the public star count, and the repository URL. It does not list private repositories, and it does not read issues, pull requests, or commit bodies. A star count of zero is a real zero, not a placeholder. **ORE.** Dexscreener token `oreoU2P8bN6jkk3jbaiVxYnG1dCXcYxwhwyK9jSybcp` on Solana. The page keeps the pair with the highest reported liquidity whose base symbol is ORE, then shows the USD price and the 24 hour change. **SOL.** Dexscreener token `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`, the wrapped SOL mint, same liquidity rule, same 24 hour field. **USDC.** Coinbase spot `USDC-USD`. The change is shown as `0.0%` because that endpoint returns a spot amount, not a 24 hour percent. The price is the spot. It is not a made-up peg. **Ask.** `POST https://text.pollinations.ai/openai` with model `openai`. That name is the anonymous model on the classic free router. The page prints the text in `choices[0].message.content` and nothing else. It does not claim the answer came from Claude, Gemini, or Grok. If a feed fails, the page says which feed failed. It does not fall back to a canned price. ## What is not live A static page cannot do the jobs that need a secret or a signature. - It cannot call xAI. Grok 4.5 and Grok 4.6 stay on a server that holds `XAI_API_KEY`. - It cannot call FreeLLMAPI. That router is local, at a `/v1` you run, and it wants `FREELLMAPI_URL` plus `FREELLMAPI_KEY`. - It cannot place an order on an exchange. There is no wallet, no transaction, and no "confirm trade" button. - It cannot see private GitHub data, Slack, a calendar account, or a bank. - It cannot speak with a paid voice, draw an image, or render a clip. Those benches exist only where a server key is present. - The crew sentence is a reading of the mark you just fetched. It is not a forecast and not a fill. If a sentence on the desk says "no order was sent", that sentence is the product rule, not a caption on a hidden trade. ## How the page is built The file is one HTML document. CSS and JavaScript sit in the same file so GitHub Pages has nothing to compile. The type is dark. The background is `#030806`. The mark is `#3dff8a`. Negative percents use `#ff6b6b`. Body type is IBM Plex Mono, with Chakra Petch on the wordmark, both loaded from Google Fonts. If the font host is blocked, the page falls back to a monospace stack and still works. Layout is a header, four counters, then two cards. The left card is GitHub. The right card is Ask. Under them, three crew lines. On a narrow screen the counters are two columns. From 900 pixels wide they are four, and the two cards sit side by side. Buttons are at least 44 pixels tall. Links open in a new tab with `rel="noreferrer"`. The prompt field stops at 500 characters, matching the cap used by the server desk. There is no framework, no analytics snippet, and no cookie banner because the page sets no cookie. The only storage is whatever the browser does for a normal fetch. The desk does not write `localStorage` on this static build. ## Request shapes GitHub, Dexscreener, and Coinbase are simple GETs. The browser sends them because those hosts answer with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. If a host drops that header, the page will show a failure instead of a number. Do not proxy them through a hidden server and then describe the result as a direct read. The Ask body is: ```json { "model": "openai", "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "" }] } ``` The page does not send a system prompt, a temperature, or a tool list. The free router may still wrap the answer. What you see is the message content, trimmed only by the router itself. Status handling: | Status | What the page prints | | --- | --- | | 200 with text | The reply | | 402 | Free router allows one reply every 30 seconds | | Other non-200 | Free router refused the ask, plus the status | | Network error | Free router did not answer | | 200 with an empty choice | Empty reply | There is no retry loop. A second press before the window resets will hit the same limit and say so. ## Marks, in detail A mark has two parts: a dollar price and a signed percent. The percent comes from Dexscreener `priceChange.h24` for ORE and SOL. The page formats a negative number with a minus sign and one decimal, for example `−3.1%`. A positive number gets a plus. Zero prints as `+0.0%` for those two, and as `0.0%` for USDC, because USDC has no 24 hour field on the spot call. The dollar print uses two decimals at or above one dollar, and four decimals below that. ORE and SOL are both well above one dollar at the time this desk was wired, so you should see cents, not a long tail. If a future print is a fraction of a dollar, the page will show four places rather than round it to zero. Pair choice matters. Dexscreener returns many pools. The page filters to Solana, then to the base symbol, then sorts by reported liquidity in USD and keeps the first. That is a display rule, not a best-execution rule. A thin pool can still win if the API lists it with the highest liquidity figure. The page does not check that figure against a second source. USDC is read from Coinbase, not from a Solana pool, so its price is not mixed with the ORE pool's quote token. If Coinbase fails and Dexscreener succeeds, the ORE and SOL tiles update and the USDC tile stays on the loading mark. The crew copy uses only the ORE change. If that change is below zero, Thesis calls ORE the red sleeve. If it is not, Thesis says there is no red sleeve on ORE. SOL can be red on the tile and still not move the Thesis line. That is deliberate and small. The static crew is a reading aid, not the five-seat pass described later. ## The five-seat crew, and why the page is smaller The command-centre design has five seats: Watch, Thesis, Size, Risk, and Clerk. You are the gate between Risk and Clerk. Watch reads the marks. Thesis states one claim and labels it inferred. Size proposes a weight move that still sums to 100. Risk holds the pen and refuses a live order. Clerk writes a receipt only after you sign. A refusal writes a receipt too, and the weights do not move. The public page shows Watch and Thesis only, plus a Size line that says the book stays at 100. It does not keep weights, it does not offer Sign, and it does not write a receipt. Those steps need a store. On the server desk the store is `localStorage` under the name `bro-command-v1`. Signing there still does not broadcast a transaction. It changes the weights in the browser and appends a line to the local ledger. If you expected the public page to rebalance a wallet, it will not. The red sleeve is a color on a percent. The next action is yours, outside this page. ## Model seats on a server desk When BRO runs as a server, the roster is larger than the public page. The public page has one anonymous model. The server roster is a list of seats, and each seat has a wire. The wire is either xAI or the free router. The reply names the model that actually answered. | Seat | Wire when a server is up | If FreeLLMAPI is configured | If it is not | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Qwen 7B | edge | `auto:fast` | anonymous `openai` | | Llama 8B | edge | `auto:fast` | anonymous `openai` | | kimi-k3 | edge | `auto:fast` | anonymous `openai` | | Grok 4.5 | xAI `grok-4.5` | still xAI | still xAI | | Grok 4.6 | xAI `grok-4.6` | still xAI | still xAI | | Claude | main | `auto` | anonymous `openai` | | Codex | main | `auto:smart` | anonymous `openai` | | Gemini | main | `auto` | anonymous `openai` | | Gemini 3.5 | main | `auto:smart` | anonymous `openai` | | DeepSeek | main | `auto` | anonymous `openai` | Read that table as routing policy, not as a claim that Claude is on the key. The xAI key in the server environment has served `grok-4.5` and `grok-4.6`. It does not serve Claude, Gemini, or Codex. Those names are seats. When FreeLLMAPI is offline, Ask says `openai` in the reply so you can see the substitution. When FreeLLMAPI is online, the reply can include the `X-Routed-Via` header, which is the chain the router actually used. Grok stays on xAI even if FreeLLMAPI is up. The queen path is separate from the free chains. The public page has no queen path at all. Virtual models on FreeLLMAPI, when you point the server at your own router: - `auto` is the best open chain. - `auto:fast` is the cheap, quick chain. Edge seats use it. - `auto:smart` is the harder chain. Codex and Gemini 3.5 use it. Those three buttons are closed in the interface until both environment variables are set. The check is a boolean. The URL and the key are not sent to the browser. ## One door The server desk has a probe box called One Door. You type a job. A local function, `routeWork`, picks a seat and a spare. The rule is short. If the text matches review, code, deploy, trade, research, and the other heavy words, or if it is long, the tier is main. If it matches format, classify, remind, status, and the other light words, the tier is edge. The seat is chosen from the seats in that tier that you have not tripped. A hash of the text spreads jobs across the open seats so the same sentence does not always land on the same name. Trip a seat and the next job skips it. Restore it and it returns to the pool. One Door does not call a model until you press Ask. The pick is visible first: seat, spare, and tier. That is the point of the door. You see the route, then you decide to spend a call. The public page does not run `routeWork`. It has one Ask button and one model name. If you want the door, you want the server desk, not the Pages file. ## Voice, stills, and clips On the server desk the command line accepts a few intents. - A normal line is either a local command or a question for the queen. - "Say" opens the studio and speaks. The browser voice is the default. A Grok voice toggle uses the server text-to-speech path and falls back to the browser if that path fails. - "Draw" and "clip" call the server media functions. They need the same xAI key. They do not run on the public page. - Assign, remember, approve, and deny change the local store. They do not post to GitHub or to a social network. A draft can be marked posted. That mark is a checkbox in the store, not a publish. The microphone uses the browser speech recognizer when the browser has one. If it does not, the button stays disabled. Recognition is one shot, English, with interim results off. The heard line is submitted like a typed line. None of that is in `index.html`. Listing it here is so the public page is not confused with the full desk. ## GitHub Pages, exactly GitHub Pages serves files. It does not run a Node server. That is why this repository is one HTML file. The user site `codesbyfebin.github.io` publishes from the `docs` directory on `main`. A file at `docs/bro/index.html` becomes `https://codesbyfebin.github.io/bro/`. The root of that repository is not the published root. Putting the desk at `/bro/index.html` on that repo does nothing until it is also under `docs`. This repository, `BRO-Personal-Ai`, holds the source copy at `/index.html`. Turning on Pages for this repository itself needs the Pages API, and the token used to push the first commit could not change that setting. The live URL above is the one that already builds. If you later enable Pages on this repository from the GitHub UI, the same `index.html` will serve at `https://codesbyfebin.github.io/BRO-Personal-Ai/` without a build. `.nojekyll` is in the root so a future Pages setting that uses this repository will not hide the file or rewrite it. The user site already has its own `.nojekyll` under `docs`. There is no GitHub Action in this repository. The page does not need one. A push of `index.html` is the release. ## Run it yourself From a clone: ```bash git clone https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/BRO-Personal-Ai.git cd BRO-Personal-Ai python3 -m http.server 8080 ``` Open `http://127.0.0.1:8080/`. Some browsers block `file://` fetches. Use a local server if the tiles stay on "loading". To refresh the public copy, edit `index.html` here, copy it to `docs/bro/index.html` on `codesbyfebin.github.io`, and push that repository. Pages rebuilds on its own. A rebuild often finishes in under a minute. Until the build status is `built`, the old file can still be what you see. ## Design The desk is a reading surface, not a marketing site. Numbers are tabular. Labels are short and tracked out. The only motion on the public page is a slow glow on the Watch line, so you can see that the crew row is the live one. The glow is a box shadow. It does not move layout. Color is limited on purpose. | Token | Hex | Use | | --- | --- | --- | | Background | `#030806` | Page | | Surface | `#0b1410` | Cards | | Line | `#1c3328` | Borders | | Text | `#e7f6ee` | Body | | Muted | `#7d9b89` | Hints | | Primary | `#3dff8a` | Marks, links, the wordmark | | Danger | `#ff6b6b` | A negative 24 hour change | The hero at the top of this README is the same palette: a green wordmark, a thin ring, and empty dark around it. It is not a screenshot of an account, and it is not a third-party logo. ## Privacy The public page sends your Ask text to the free router. Treat that box like a message to a third party. Do not paste keys, wallet seeds, or private mail. The GitHub call is a read of a public user. It sends no authentication header. Anyone can make the same request. Dexscreener and Coinbase see your IP the way any public API does. The page adds no tracking parameter. The server desk, where it exists, keeps tasks, approvals, memory, and the book in `localStorage` on that browser. Clearing site data clears the desk. The xAI key never goes to the browser. Media calls are server functions. If you fork this HTML file and paste a key into it, you have broken that rule. Do not. ## Limits you will hit The free router is shared and anonymous. One reply about every 30 seconds is the limit the page was written against. A busy address can be slower or emptier. The page will not queue prompts. GitHub's public API is rate limited by IP. A normal Sync is one call. A script that hammers Sync from one address will get `403` or `429`, and the card will say GitHub did not answer. Dexscreener can return an empty pair list. The tile then stays on the loading mark and the feed line says the marks did not load. That is better than showing yesterday's number with no label. Coinbase can change the spot field. The page reads `data.amount`. If that field disappears, USDC stays unloaded and the other two marks can still render. The page does not paginate GitHub. You see up to six repositories, the most recently pushed. A repository that has not been pushed recently will not appear even if it is important. Open the GitHub profile for the full list. ## Operator notes Use the public page to see whether the feeds are alive and to ask a short question that can survive a public log. Use a server desk when you need Grok, a signature, or a model roster. When you read a mark, read the percent and the dollar together. A green percent on a thin pool is still just a percent. The page does not tell you the pool's liquidity on the tile. If you need that, open the Dexscreener pair yourself. The mint addresses are in this README so you can. When Thesis says ORE is red, it means the 24 hour field was negative. It does not mean the book should move. On the server desk, Size may propose a five-point shift toward USDC, and you still have to sign. On this page, no shift is offered. When Ask returns a fluent paragraph, the fluency is the router's, not a receipt from this desk. The desk did not check the facts. If you need a number from the tiles, read the tiles. Do not ask the model to repeat them and then trust the repeat. ## Failure stories These are the failures the page is built to show, rather than hide. The GitHub request throws. The feed line says GitHub did not answer. The repository list stays empty. The counters for marks can still fill, because that work is a separate try. The mark requests throw. The feed line says the marks did not load. GitHub can still list repositories. Watch stays on "Waiting on marks." Thesis stays on the idle claim. The page does not invent `+2.4%`. Ask is pressed with an empty box. Nothing is sent. Ask is pressed twice in a few seconds. The second call is the one that usually sees `402`. The first reply, if it arrived, stays on screen until the second response replaces it. There is no history stack on the public page. Copy the line if you need to keep it. The font host is down. The page uses the fallback monospace. Layout does not depend on the webfont metrics beyond the wordmark size. JavaScript is off. You see the header and empty cards. The desk cannot fetch without a script. There is no server-rendered number to fall back to, because Pages is not running a server. ## What a fork should keep If you fork the page, keep the sentences that say where a number came from. Replace the GitHub user if you want your own repositories. Replace the mints if you want other assets. Do not leave the CodesbyFebin name on a page that reads someone else's account, and do not leave the ORE mint in place if you have swapped the symbol. Keep the status text for `402`. People will press Ask twice. A silent failure looks like a broken button. Keep the "no order" line. The moment the page shows a price, some readers will think a button sells it. The page has no such button. The sentence is there so the UI does not imply one. Do not add a key to the HTML to "upgrade" Ask to a named cloud model. If you want named models, run a router on a server and call it from a server. The FreeLLMAPI notes above are the shape of that upgrade. The key stays in the environment. ## Relation to other desks BRO has been sketched against three outside patterns, without copying their brands and without calling them from this page. A one-door router is the idea that one job enters and a policy picks a seat, with a spare if the seat is down. One Door on the server desk is that idea, implemented as a local function. This page is the smaller version: one job, one anonymous model, no spare. An agent card is a seat with a skill and a text modality. The server colony shows those cards. A job moves through queued, running, and review. Nothing on the card calls an outside agent by itself. A voice bench is a local listen button plus a separate spend path for a paid voice. The server studio splits them. This page has neither, because both need a browser permission or a key, and the public file keeps the surface to reads and one anonymous ask. FreeLLMAPI is a local OpenAI-shaped router with virtual models `auto`, `auto:fast`, and `auto:smart`, and a response header that names the chain. The server desk can call it. This repository does not embed it. You run it yourself if you want those chains. ## FAQ **Is the price on the tile a quote I can hit?** No. It is a public print from Dexscreener or Coinbase at the moment of the fetch. It can be stale by the time you read it. Sync again if you need a newer print. Neither source is your broker. **Does Ask use Grok?** Not on this page. The reply is from the anonymous `openai` model on the free router. Grok is used only on a server that has an xAI key, and only after you send a line. **Why do the tiles sometimes disagree with an exchange app?** The pool, the venue, and the clock differ. This page picks one liquid Solana pair and one Coinbase spot. Your app may use another venue. The page does not blend them. **Can I trade from the crew lines?** No. Watch and Thesis are sentences. There is no size button on the public page. **Where are the other nine models?** They are seats on the server desk. They are not separate calls on this page. See the table above before you tell someone Claude answered. **Why is the live site not on this repository's Pages URL?** The token that created the commit could not enable Pages here. The user site was already publishing from `docs`, so the file was placed at `docs/bro/index.html` there. The source you are reading is still this repository. **Does the page track me?** It does not set a cookie and it does not load an analytics script. The APIs you call see a normal browser request. **Can I run this offline?** You can open the file. The tiles and Ask need the network. There is no cached price in the file, on purpose. **What license is this?** This repository does not ship a license file yet. Do not assume a grant that is not written down. ## A short tour, in order Open the live URL. The header is the word BRO and a clock. The clock uses your machine's locale, with hours and minutes, and it updates every 15 seconds. It is not a market clock and not a session clock from an exchange. The four counters start as ellipses. They fill when the fetches return. GitHub's counter is the number of repositories in the list, at most six. The other three counters are the 24 hour percents, or `0.0%` for USDC. Under each percent is the dollar print, in smaller type. The GitHub card lists names as links. The star count sits on the right. Sync is under the list. The line under Sync is the feed status. A good fetch says the repos and marks are live and that no order was sent. A bad fetch names the side that failed. The Ask card has one sentence of warning, a field, and a button. The field starts with a harmless prompt so you can see a round trip without inventing one. Change it before you press Ask if you want a different question. The reply replaces the status line under the button. It is not pushed into a log. The crew card is last. Watch updates when ORE has a price. Thesis updates from the sign of the ORE percent. Size does not update, because the public page does not keep weights. The note under the card repeats the rule: live marks, and a pass does not send an order. There is no pass button. The sentence is aimed at the reader who will look for one. That is the whole page. If you see a control that is not in this tour, it is not part of this repository's build. ## Numbers the desk refuses to invent Older sketches of this desk carried sample marks, sample pull-request counts, and a mirror tick that incremented when you pressed Sync. Those numbers were labels. They were not fetches. The public page does not do that. Sync does not add one to a commit counter. It asks GitHub again. If GitHub returns the same six names, the card looks the same. That is a successful refresh, not a stuck button. The book does not start at a fake `+2.4%`. It starts blank and waits. A blank tile is an unloaded tile. A filled tile is a fetch. There is no third state. The queen, on a server, is told not to invent pull requests, balances, or prices. The public page enforces the same idea by not asking the model to be the source of the tiles. The tiles are the source. The model is a separate box. ## If you are wiring a server later Keep the public page dumb. Add the server beside it, not inside the HTML. Set `FREELLMAPI_URL` to the origin plus `/v1`, for example `http://127.0.0.1:3001/v1`. Set `FREELLMAPI_KEY` to the router key. Do not commit either value. The server should reject any URL that is not `http` or `https`. Set `XAI_API_KEY` only on the server. Call `grok-4.5` for the queen and `grok-4.6` for that seat. Cap the tokens. If the call fails, say it failed. Do not answer as Grok from the free router and keep the Grok label. When a non-Grok seat falls through to `openai`, print both names. The seat is what you asked. `openai` is what spoke. Readers can forgive a fallback. They cannot forgive a label that hides it. Store signatures locally. A signed line is a receipt in the ledger. It is not a transaction hash. If you later attach a real signer, that is a different product, and this README should be rewritten before that button ships. ## Credits The desk is a CodesbyFebin project. The public reads use GitHub, Dexscreener, and Coinbase. The anonymous ask uses the classic Pollinations text endpoint. None of those providers are affiliated with this repository. Their names are here because the page calls them, not because they endorse it. The hero image is a wordmark for this README. It is not a trademark filing and not a screenshot of the live page. ## Status The public desk is a static file with live reads and one anonymous ask. The server roster, the signing crew, and the voice bench are described so they are not confused with this file. If a line in this README and a button on the live page disagree, trust the page, then fix the README. The page is the build. This document is the map.
